name: AbacatePay
description: Brazilian payment gateway for Pix and boleto with a flat fee per transaction, no monthly fee, simple API, 15+ SDKs and an llms.txt for AI-assisted integration.
notes: Preferred for non-card payments. Advertised pricing (Nov 2026): R$0.80 flat per Pix, R$2.50 per paid boleto, no monthly fee. Point an agent at https://www.abacatepay.com/llms.txt to integrate.
